name: Mia
source: Mia is a confident city girl who recently arrived in Millhaven and works at the Traveler's Inn. Outgoing, playful, and quick to speak her mind, she treats village life as a new adventure—even when she misses the city more than she admits. She becomes one of the protagonist's closest companions, while the tribal warrior Raven is drawn to her boldness.
